subject: Step3 async submit: bridge side done (gated OFF), frontend hooks needed in compute_frontend.m teguExecute (yours)
body: Bridge (uncommitted, host-only): n2mb_async(b,mode) / env NORD2_METAL_ASYNC=1 (probes WAIT_SEQ(0,0); stays sync on a kernel without 0090) and n2mb_wait_pending(b,&failed_job). In mode 1 draw/draw_v2-v4/clear/batch return after SUBMIT_JM (reply=job id); newest id kept; one WAIT_SEQ reaps. Bridge waits by itself before: snapshot SYNC+memcpy, n2mb_copy, n2mb_method 5/7 (compute, pipeline import), tiler matrix, traces/diag (forced ordered), alloc retry under budget (deferred frees only happen when the context is idle), close. Release of a BO while jobs are unreaped -> kernel kIOReturnBusy 'consumed', accepted only when async && pending. In-flight window busy -> reap + resubmit once. GPU failure surfaces at the next reap (first_failed_id) and breaks the bridge like a failed sync WAIT. Tests: metal_bridge_test fake kernel models WAIT_SEQ, busy-consumed release, 96-style window, failure; SYNC asserts no pending job. FRONTEND HOOKS REQUIRED before anyone enables it (compute_frontend.m teguExecute, your file): (a) before every CPU job (j->blit paths, fill rows, tegu_shadow_sync_jobs(...,1) after the loop): n2mb_wait_pending(d->connection,NULL); (b) before storing status 4/5: e=n2mb_wait_pending(d->connection,&failed); if(e)error=e (attribute to the command, log failed id); (c) optional symbol weak-check like n2mb_draw_v2. With (b) at the end of every command buffer the gain is only intra-command overlap (bridge build/CPU work of segment k+1 while GPU runs k) + fewer WAIT syscalls; cross-command overlap would need deferring (b) to a completion thread - not proposed now. Needs kernel 0090 on device; not hardware verified.
